title: Pure White Forest

allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: fetches Diabellze the White Witch, a Level 8 Illusion that is always treated as White Forest.
allow.Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card: swaps a White Forest Spellcaster or Illusion for one in the GY, and sets itself again when a White Forest monster sends it as a cost.

summary: Pure White Forest build with generic staples and two shared Sinful Spoils cards. White Forest monsters pay their costs by sending a Spell or Trap from the hand or field to the GY, and the White Forest Spells and Traps set themselves back to the field whenever they are sent to the GY to activate a monster's effect.

summary.title: Starters
points: Elzette of the White Forest sends a Spell/Trap from the hand or field to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand and search any White Forest monster.

Astellar of the White Forest sends a Spell/Trap from the hand or field to the GY to Special Summon a LIGHT Spellcaster Tuner from the Deck, such as Silvy of the White Forest or Rucia of the White Forest.
Silvy of the White Forest searches a White Forest Spell/Trap on Normal or Special Summon, and Witch of the White Forest searches a White Forest monster on activation.

summary.title: Opening: Elzette of the White Forest + Spell/Trap
steps: Send a Spell/Trap (ideally Tales of the White Forest, which resets itself) to the GY to Special Summon Elzette of the White Forest and search Silvy of the White Forest.
Normal Summon Silvy to search Tales of the White Forest or Woes of the White Forest, then Synchro Summon Level 6 Rciela, Sinister Soul of the White Forest.

Send a Spell/Trap to the GY with Rciela to search another White Forest or LIGHT Spellcaster card, then return Rciela or Silvera from the GY to the Extra Deck with Silvy or Rucia to revive the Tuner and Synchro Summon Level 8 Diabell, Queen of the White Forest.

summary.title: Self-Resetting Spell/Trap Costs
summary.text: Tales of the White Forest, Sinful Spoils of the White Forest, Beware the White Forest, Scourge of the White Forest, Woes of the White Forest, and Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils all Set themselves back from the GY when sent there to activate a monster's effect. Sending them to pay for Elzette, Astellar, Rucia, Diabellze the White Witch, or Rciela gives you the monster's effect for free while putting the Spell or Trap right back on the field.

summary.title: Control & Synchros
points: Diabell, Queen of the White Forest recovers any Spell/Trap from the GY when Synchro Summoned using a Synchro Tuner, and when the opponent activates a card or effect she sends a Spell/Trap to the GY to Special Summon a Level 7 or lower Synchro Tuner (such as Silvera, Wolf Tamer of the White Forest to flip all opposing monsters face-down, or Poplar of the White Forest).
Poplar of the White Forest places up to two White Forest monsters from the GY into the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells and Quick-Effect Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn.

Diabellze the White Witch (always treated as a White Forest card) protects your monsters from destruction by the opponent's effects while you control two or more White Forest monsters, and Azamina Aphes bounces cards up to the number of Fusion and Synchro Spellcasters/Illusions you control.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The full Diabellstar and Azamina engines have their own dedicated lists.

Silvy of the White Forest
Tuner: searches a White Forest Spell/Trap; returns from the GY on either turn.
Rucia of the White Forest
Tuner: summons itself next to a White Forest monster; sends a Spell/Trap to draw.
Astellar of the White Forest
Sends a Spell/Trap to summon a LIGHT Spellcaster Tuner from the Deck.
Diabellze the White Witch
Newest monster, treated as White Forest: summons itself by sending a Spell/Trap; protects your monsters.
Elzette, Azamina of the White Forest
Reveals itself to summon a White Forest monster from the hand.
Witch of the White Forest
Newest Field Spell: searches a White Forest monster; makes one a Tuner.
Tales of the White Forest
Searches a White Forest monster; sets itself again when sent as a cost.
Sinful Spoils of the White Forest
Quick-Play: summons a Spellcaster or Illusion from the hand, or Fusion Summons.
Beware the White Forest
Destroys a card with a Level 6+ Spellcaster or Illusion out.
Scourge of the White Forest
Quick-Play: tributes a Synchro to negate a card and revive an Illusion.
Woes of the White Forest
Summons a White Forest monster from the Deck, then Synchro Summons.
Azamina Aphes
Treated as White Forest: bounces a card for each Fusion and Synchro you have.
